digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: The legacy inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after successful new-writer saves, with chronological maximum promoted to get_rotation.json before inline scrubbing.
Sidecar persistence must complete atomically before bindings serialization; if sidecar write fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value retained as a failure floor.
A crash or write failure after sidecar persist but before bindings replace must not lose the maximum rotation value, which is already durable in the sidecar.
An old-writer then new-writer sequence must converge by migrating any reintroduced later inline timestamp into the sidecar-persisted maximum and then scrubbing it from bindings.json.
All writer instances (GHA reconciler and local probe) must be descended from the A2-1 merge commit and explicitly refreshed before the compatibility gate is satisfied.
